features.f6Desc: See your total products, active customers, open conversations, and orders at a glance. Know your business in seconds.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Connect the channels your customers message you on. Telegram is the quickest to set up.
channels.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {name}? Messages from this channel will stop reaching your assistant.

telegram.tagline: Connect a Telegram bot. Fastest to set up.
telegram.setupNote: We register the webhook with Telegram for you — messages start flowing right away.
steps: Choose a name and username for your bot.
Copy the bot token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
Click Connect — we'll register the webhook automatically.

secret_token.label: Webhook secret
secret_token.help: Optional. Telegram sends this back with every update so we can verify it came from them.

messenger.tagline: Reply to your Facebook Page messages.
messenger.setupNote: We subscribe your Page automatically, but you must paste the callback URL and verify token into the Meta App dashboard yourself.
steps: Create an app at developers.facebook.com and add the Messenger product.
Generate a Page access token and copy your Page ID and App Secret.
Connect here — we'll give you a callback URL.
In Meta → Messenger → Webhooks, paste the callback URL and your verify token.
Subscribe the Page to the 'messages' field.

access_token.label: Page access token
access_token.help: Meta App dashboard → Messenger → Settings → Generate token.

external_id.label: Facebook Page ID
external_id.help: Required — we use this to subscribe your Page to the app.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.help: Used to verify that incoming webhooks really came from Meta.

secret_token.label: Verify token
secret_token.help: You'll paste this same value into the Meta dashboard when setting the callback URL.

instagram.tagline: Reply to Instagram DMs. Requires Meta app review.
instagram.setupNote: Instagram webhooks must be configured entirely in the Meta App dashboard. Needs an Instagram Business account and Meta app review.
steps: Convert your Instagram account to a Business account.
Request the instagram_business_basic and instagram_business_manage_messages permissions, and submit for Meta app review.
Connect here — we'll give you a callback URL.
In Meta → Instagram → Webhooks, paste the callback URL and verify token.
Subscribe the account to the 'messages' field.

app_secret.label: App secret
app_secret.help: Used to verify that incoming webhooks really came from Meta.

website.tagline: Add the assistant to your own site.
website.setupNote: Nothing to register — point your widget's POST requests at the URL we generate.
steps: Choose a widget key and, ideally, list the origins allowed to use it.
Connect here to get your widget's POST URL.
Have your site POST { session_id, message, name? } to that URL.
Add your site's origin to the API's CORS_ORIGINS so the browser allows the call.

access_token.label: Widget key
access_token.placeholder: A public key for your widget
access_token.help: This is a public identifier, not a secret — it ships in your site's JavaScript.

secret_token.label: Allowed origins
secret_token.help: Comma-separated. Requests from other origins are rejected. Leave blank to allow any origin.
